title: Aaron Donald's status for Week 1 still TBD, all players set to travel to Australia

sources.title: Aaron Donald's status for Week 1 still TBD, all players set to travel to Australia
sources.description: At this point, it's still unclear whether or not Aaron Donald will play when the Rams take on the 49ers next week to open the 2026 season.
